goal: Prove the full deadline program composes: the entire verification gate passes and the agent SDK stays optional, so no call-site task left a divergent ad-hoc timeout or weakened an existing assertion.

graders.run: uv run pytest -k "module_purity or sdk_optional or import_without"
graders.name: purity-and-optional-extra-holdout

relevant: scripts/check.sh -- the full gate (ruff -> pyright -> pytest); the standing Definition-of-Done for this program
constraints: This task adds no new behavior; it is the composition holdout that runs the dependents' surfaces together.
`import flywheel_core` must succeed with the SDK extra absent; no top-level claude_agent_sdk import may have been added by any dependent.
If the gate is red, the defect is in a dependent task's change -- do not weaken any check to make it pass; fix the dependent.
Commit any reconciliation (e.g. a shared-config wiring fix) before reporting done.
non_goals: Do not weaken, delete, skip, or relax any assertion, test, lint rule, or type check to make the gate pass.
Do not add new feature behavior here -- only compose and reconcile the seam across the five call-site tasks.
Do not modify the deadline primitive's contract here; if a dependent diverged, reconcile the dependent.
edge_cases: The full ruff->pyright->pytest gate is green across all five workspace packages.
A dependent that introduced a top-level SDK import or broke core purity must surface here as a red gate, not pass silently.
